mapper.select: SELECT RELATE_TYPE FROM ( SELECT RELATE_TYPE FROM TBL_MENTORING_RELATE WHERE MENTORING_NUM = #{mentoringNum} AND USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY REG_DATE DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_MENTORING_RELATE (RELATE_NUM, MENTORING_NUM, USER_ID, RELATE_TYPE, REG_DATE) VALUES (SEQ_MENTORING_RELATE.NEXTVAL, #{mentoringNum}, #{userId}, #{relateType}, SYSDATE)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TBL_MENTORING_RELATE WHERE MENTORING_NUM = #{mentoringNum} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
